title: PAR-134 MLEADER entity/context CMC name/book retention
scope: Retain optional CMC color/book names for MLEADER entity-level and embedded-context colors
Use the bounded detached R2007+ string stream for parser and writer paths
Verify method, payload, flags, string order, and fail-before-output conditions

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 defines generic CMC optional color/book flags; §§20.4.48 and 20.4.86 identify the entity/context color fields as CMC. This does not define a corresponding DXF mapping for all names/books.

localSource.finding: The local MLEADER parser previously discarded CMC optional strings for entity/context colors; writers emitted empty name flags. The models now retain them, and parse/write paths use the bounded detached string stream.
localSource.compatibility: Six entity-level strings and six context strings were appended after prior state, preserving previous member offsets but changing public class/context sizes. Downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual method changed.

generatedControls.finding: Named C0–C3 methods are exercised on leader-line and active context colors; named C2 is exercised on all three entity-level colors. Independent wire walking verifies method/payload/flags and consumes color/book strings in stream order. Parser checks verify all strings and following-handle alignment. Fail-closed controls cover missing detached string output and inactive context names.
generatedControls.limit: Generated vectors establish local codec consistency only; they are not producer-authored or native-consumer evidence.

productionSummary: Append name/book fields for MLEADER entity-level and embedded-context CMC colors.
Capture CMC name/book strings using the bounded detached string stream.
Emit C0/C1/C2/C3 and optional names/books in the same detached stream.
Reject invalid/inactive CMC state and missing/aliased string buffers before body output.
Preserve/reset fields through MLEADER copy, assignment, and parser reset.
